name: PasswordCheckerWeb
description: A lightweight Flask web application that evaluates password strength using zxcvbn, checks for compromised passwords against Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) using k-Anonymity for privacy, and generates high-entropy passphrases based on the official 7,776-word EFF Large Wordlist.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent storage directory for application state

variables.name: Redis Host
variables.description: IP address or Docker container name of your Redis server (e.g. redis or 192.168.1.X).

variables.name: Redis Password
variables.description: Optional password for Redis authentication (leave blank if no auth required).

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Optional direct Redis connection URI (e.g., redis://:password@192.168.1.X:6379/0). Overrides Redis Host/Port settings if set. Leave blank to use discrete Redis Host/Port.

variables.name: Disable Telemetry
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable anonymous startup telemetry metrics.
